title: Skeleton on Pier
description: A skeleton in a purple hooded robe stands on a wooden pier over water. The skeleton holds a red dripping gun in one hand and an alarm clock in the other while red paint runs down the pier.
prompt: a skeleton wearing a purple hooded robe stands on a wooden pier over water holding a red dripping gun in one hand and a large alarm clock in the other with red paint running down the pier a blue dragon flies in the sky above many floating clocks fill the air a green skeleton elephant rides a broomstick a grim reaper with scythe floats in the clouds and many small boats with glowing pagodas are on the water
